responsibility: Autogenerated companion table for the SH target option definitions in `gcc/config/sh/sh.opt`. It belongs to GCC’s option-documentation metadata rather than code generation itself, mapping each supported SH `-m` option name to the corresponding anchor in the generated `SH-Options.html` manual so diagnostics, help, or tooling that expose option documentation can attach the right manual URL; options with no discovered manual anchor are intentionally omitted or marked as skipped.
